definitions.explanation: A decorated evergreen tree (real or artificial) displayed indoors as part of Christmas celebrations. Adopted from Western tradition and widely seen in Japanese homes, schools, and commercial spaces during December.

examples.japanese: クリスマスツリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧クリスマスツリー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: The children opened presents under the Christmas tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧クリスマスツリー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}てられる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: A large Christmas tree is set up every year in the plaza in front of the station.

notes:
From English "Christmas tree." In Japan, Christmas is primarily a secular romantic and commercial holiday rather than a religious one, but the decorated tree is a near-universal symbol of the season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クリスマスツリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to decorate a Christmas tree
- クリスマスツリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up a Christmas tree
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧クリスマスツリー: a large Christmas tree
- クリスマスツリー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: under the Christmas tree

SIMILAR WORDS:
- もみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧: fir tree — the traditional species used for Christmas trees
